deadline.value: January 15, 2027 is the deadline for admission and funding for fall 2027; international applicants seeking admission without funding have until April 1, 2027.
deadline.quote: January 15 for applicants seeking admission and funding for the following fall semester

also.quote: April 1 for international applicants seeking admission but not funding for the following fall semester

app_fee.value: The application processing fee is $100 for international applicants.
app_fee.quote: A $50 ($100 for international applicants) non-refundable application processing fee is required to submit your online application

gre_general.value: The School of Geosciences does not require the GRE.
gre_general.quote: No, the GRE is not required.

supervisor.value: You must identify a faculty member willing to supervise your thesis or dissertation before applying.
supervisor.quote: Yes, you must identify a faculty member who is willing to serve as your thesis or dissertation supervisor

entry_route.value: Most students hold a master's first, but a B.S.-to-Ph.D. route exists.
entry_route.quote: Most students complete a Master’s degree before entering our Ph.D. program. However, there is a B.S. to Ph.D. process that students and advisors may use to enter the Ph.D. program without first completing a Master’s
